title: Package.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe a package resource.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

bundleIds.description: The list of bundle identifiers contained in the package.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time that the package was created.

description.description: A short description of the package.

hash.description: The hex string hash of the package file.

name.description: The display name of the package.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time that the package was last updated.

url.description: The HTTPS URL to download the package.

version.description: The version string of the package.
